rv.q: It’s rare and thrilling to see an artist working on this scale.
Together they create a dreamlike landscape, a playground for Abramovic’s brilliant imagination.

The core creative team is an impressive mix of artists from across the Balkans, including Albanian choreographer Blenard Azizaj, world-renowned Serbian fashion designer Roksanda Ilinčić and the Serbian composers Marko Nikodijević and Luka Kozlovački.
Marina Abramovic's latest four-hour epic Balkan erotic is a full-on five senses sensual challenge that literally blows your mind with its possibilities.

cn.t: Critics hail Abramović's four-hour Balkan folklore spectacle as ambitious and thrilling, with 75 performers delivering a bold exploration of sexuality and spirituality that resists simple titillation and showcases epic scale.
